name: Error

sections.heading: Origin and explicit import
sections.text: Implicit origin: PRELUDE. Original module: std.core. Explicit alternative: import "std.core" { Error; }.explicit; --no-prelude removes implicit visibility. Import every referenced prelude name explicitly; imports grant no capability.

sections.heading: Behavior, methods and protocols
sections.text: code/category/source/span/cause fields preserve their typed integer values. message renders the category; withContext produces contextual messages without overwriting another live Error.

sections.heading: Ownership and effects
sections.text: Owns retained contextual text. Inspection does not publish output; console is an explicit sink.

sections.heading: Errors and limits
sections.text: Invalid spans or argument types reject. Context message capacity is bounded; the current measured pool boundary is 4084 context bytes for the filesystem message prefix.

signature: Error(code, category, sourceId, spanStart, spanEnd, causeId)
summary: A structured diagnostic value with retained identity and context.
title: std.prelude.Error
